preconditions.description: The input n must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' if n == 0 else '\n'.join(''.join(str(i) for i in range(n, j-1, -1)) for j in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The function returns an empty string if n is 0. Otherwise, it returns a string representing the pattern as described, with each line separated by a newline character.
